description: Department of Archaeology - Order under Antiquities Ordinance that declaring the 26 Monuments to be "Protected Monuments" and the objections shall be forwarded before 07.04.2017
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal notice issued by the Minister of Education under the Antiquities Ordinance, declaring specific monuments as protected monuments. It outlines the legal process for objections and provides a detailed schedule of the monuments. The core content involves the creation of a regulatory framework for heritage protection, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (new regulations and statutory instruments). While a government minister is named, the notice does not concern a personnel change or a structural change to the government itself; the minister is acting in their capacity to issue a legal/regulatory instrument.
